name: where-we-at
description: Macro checkpoint assessing the real task state against the approved plan and artifacts: what is done, missing, and remaining. Broader than slice closure. Use when the user wants a progress checkpoint, the task has multiple phases or slices, or the need is broader than closing one slice. Do not use for a single-slice task or closing one slice (use slice-closure), a brand-new task with no state, or a fast routing answer (use what-next).
